prayerExcerpt.en-US: Would you die the death of the just? there is only one way to secure the fulfilment of your wish. Live the life of the just.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Desejarias morrer a morte dos justos? há somente um caminho para assegurar o cumprimento de teu desejo. Vive a vida dos justos.

meta.face: An Italian of the Marche of about fifty-five, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a pale olive complexion thinned by fasting and a HEART-SHAPED face — a BROAD, smooth forehead tapering over HOLLOW cheeks to a SMALL, POINTED chin, a small, STRAIGHT, fine nose, LARGE, gentle dark-brown eyes set a little close under softly arched dark brows, a SMALL, sweet mouth; black hair touched with grey cut in a thick ring round a full tonsure; the gaze lowered, tender and humble. Not the round, big-nosed philip_benizi, nor the dark, compact, brow-joined peter_verona.
meta.basis: The Augustinian habit, the star, the lily and the blessed bread are his constant attributes (Santi e Beati: 'cesto di pane, pane, stella'); the lead portrait on Wikipedia shows a pale, gentle, tonsured friar. The gauntness is the book's austerity; the structure is ours.
